status: Locally fixed before the new follow-up runs; not externally preregistered. Prior Stage1-3 results informed this design.
scope: Unify the final model and measure reinsertion and weighting separately. No new state-of-the-art or flight-readiness claim.

physics.edge_occupancy: Exclusive full-edge/layer/lane occupancy, not moving-block following
physics.type_assignment: Independent uniform stream with random.Random(seed*31+7), keeping the existing request generator

policy.ablation: SPC-UR and SPC-WSR share strict construction, candidates, tie-breaking, acceptance and cap; only reinsertion pressure weights change

large.interpretation: Exploratory matched extension of already inspected corrected-domain runs; historical and new timings are not compared inferentially

sensitivity.evaluation: Always evaluate with 3/2/1; do not change the metric when changing policy weights. Scale 3/8/30 only; hold air-time coefficient fixed.
sensitivity.interpretation: Exploratory sensitivity, no parameter selected for favorable outcomes

inference.test: Two-sided Wilcoxon with SciPy auto method; Holm family of three main comparisons; all-zero differences get p=1
inference.secondary: Total delay, tail delay, within-seed priority means, structural actions and runtime are descriptive with pointwise intervals where supplied
inference.large_and_sensitivity: Descriptive paired effects only; historical 32-test family remains historical evidence
inference.sample_size: 30 new seeds fixed in advance for a paired follow-up, no formal power claim or significance-based extension

timing: Sequential runs; one BLAS/OpenMP thread requested and actual pool state saved. Include preprocessing, construction, reinsertion and reservation audit, exclude trajectory validation and I/O. Report stage times and one observation per seed.
safety: Reconstruct archived selections, validate keys and analytic speed envelopes, and sample pairwise cylindrical separation at 0.25 s. This is not continuous-time validation.
replay: Retain prior real airplane-icon frames only after rerunning seeds 24 and 4 with the unified model and checking full schedule/trajectory equivalence; otherwise regenerate the affected replay. Not part of the new-seed main comparison.
